brief:
Implement `Button` for the UpSkill design system, exported from Button/index.tsx. Build it to this approved API proposal.

Anatomy (left to right): Root, Icon, Label, TrailingIcon.

Props (export the props type as `ButtonProps`, and the axis unions as `ButtonVariant`, `ButtonSize`, `ButtonShape`):
| Prop | Concept | Kind | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `variant` | Visual weight/style | variant axis | `'accent' \| 'neutral' \| 'transparent' \| 'danger'` | `'neutral'` |
| `size` | Size | variant axis | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` |
| `shape` | Corners | variant axis | `'square' \| 'round'` | none (unset renders a labelled button; set renders an icon-only button) |
| `icon` | Icon | content | `IconName` | none (leading icon) |
| `trailingIcon` | Icon | content | `IconName` | none |
| `children` | Content | content | `ReactNode` | none (the label) |
| `disabled` | Boolean | native | `boolean` | `false` |
| `type` | native | native | `'button' \| 'submit' \| 'reset'` | `'button'` |
| `aria-label` | Accessible name | native | `string` | none |
| `onClick` | Discrete event | native | `MouseEventHandler<HTMLButtonElement>` | none |

It renders a native `<button>`; other native button attributes pass through. Style with a co-located CSS module (Button/Button.module.css) referencing only design-token custom properties. Also produce Button/Button.metadata.json that validates against the provided component.schema.json, and a behavioral a11y test Button/Button.a11y.test.tsx (Vitest + Testing Library + vitest-axe, axe's color-contrast rule disabled).

requiredPatterns.reason: the brief requires a native button element
type defaults to 'button', not the native 'submit'

forbiddenPatterns.reason: renames a concept the approved API names (variant, disabled, icon, trailingIcon)
